response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience across many languages and platforms, making him drastically overqualified and mismatched for an entry-level Junior Java Developer role; his primary expertise is in JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and full-stack web development rather than Java, and his German is only basic, falling short of the required strong verbal and written communication in German.
strengths: Extensive, proven software engineering experience across web, mobile, and backend systems
Some direct Java exposure (robotic arms, mobile orchestration tooling) and strong OOP background
Deep familiarity with agile/software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
concerns: Vastly overqualified — seniority mismatch will likely lead to poor role fit and quick disengagement
German is only 'Basic', not meeting the required strong bilingual communication for client-facing insurance projects
Career and skill focus is on JS/TypeScript/DLang, not Java, with only marginal Java project experience

key_factors.factor: Limited hands-on Java experience relative to other languages
